verdict.rationale: Foreloop runs a documented pipeline from bug report to pull request. A user submits a report through the widget, with page metadata and a screenshot. Foreloop's agent reads the submission, fills in an intention and proposes tasks. A Claude Code or Codex agent running in your checkout then claims the approved task, does the work and opens a PR. The caveats are that the fixing agent is an external tool you run on your own machine, and nothing runs until a person approves the contract, so the loop is not end-to-end autonomous. Missing for 10: a first-party agent that does the fix itself, any detail on how the agent diagnoses the root cause, a fully autonomous path with no approval gate, and independent or hands-on evidence that bug fixes actually land correctly.
